definition.simple: A very tiny, fast-moving particle with a negative charge that zooms around the outside of the atom's nucleus.
definition.academic: A stable subatomic particle with a charge of negative electricity, found in all atoms and acting as the primary carrier of electricity in solids.

examples: Electricity is just a flow of moving electrons.

common_misconceptions: Electrons are inside the nucleus. (False: They orbit around it in shells).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Electrons are the only subatomic particles involved in chemical reactions. Protons and Neutrons stay locked safely in the nucleus.
